name: Senthil Kumar
text: Buying here for 15 years. Toor dal from their own mill cooks soft every single time — you can smell the freshness. Prices are written clearly, no bargaining needed.

name: Revathi Manoharan
text: I send my list on WhatsApp in the morning and collect the packed bag in the evening. Very useful for working people — saves so much time.

name: Palanisamy
text: Good quality chekku oil and fresh murukku. Shop is small but everything is available. Parking is a little difficult on market days.

name: Fathima Begum
text: Correct weighing and fresh stock always. The akka at the counter is very helpful — she tells honestly which rice suits idli and which suits daily meals.

name: Karthik R
text: Erode turmeric and jaggery quality is superb. The rates on the website are exactly what you pay at the shop.

name: Meenakshi
text: Our family shop since my mother's time. Loose items are kept clean and covered. Would love to see more snack varieties.
